title: Mountain biking: from first ride to pro
intro: Start with your first trail-centre session, then pick a track. The leader track takes groups onto harder and wilder terrain. The coach track helps riders build their skills. Both end with kit, costs and safety.

competitions.competitions2027Label: British competitions 2027: mountain biking and BMX

items.summary: Your first trail-centre session in the UK. Then pick a track.
Off-Road Leader: lead up to 8 riders on non-technical trails and gravel, up to trail-centre blue.
Trail Leader (formerly Level 2): up to 8 riders on red-grade trails, 15 logged rides recommended.
Mountain Bike Leader (formerly Level 3): remote and severe technical terrain, plus the Remote Award.

sections.title: Coach track
sections.intro: Off-Road Leader (step 2) is a useful start for coaches too, but you don't need it.

items.summary: Introduction to Coaching – Off-Road: become an Activity Coach from 14.
Coaching in Context – MTB XC or Gravity: 100 hours of coaching in, now coach advanced skills.
Racing: Go-Ride, licences, the national XC and downhill series, and national championships including enduro and e-enduro.
Prices, who runs what, and safety. Both tracks end here.
